expectations.text: Anchors requirements to the 2017 Revised 508 Standards with WCAG 2.0 Level AA as the binding baseline
expectations.evidence: "Revised 508 Standards (36 CFR Part 1194...)"; "The Section 508 standards currently incorporate WCAG 2.0 A and AA by reference"

expectations.text: Recommends verifying accessibility of ICT deliverables at acceptance, noting the FY2025 assessment found under 30 percent of agencies almost always do this
expectations.evidence: Recommends "Acceptance testing against the standards" but never cites the FY2025 assessment's under-30-percent verification finding

expectations.text: States there is no pending refresh rulemaking to wait for
expectations.evidence: Never states there is no pending refresh; instead advises to "monitor the Access Board and FAR Council for changes"

expectations.text: Covers standard procurement artifacts such as ACRs/VPATs and testing evidence
expectations.evidence: "Require a current ACR based on the VPAT 2.x Revised Section 508 edition... Verify through your own testing (for example the DHS Trusted Tester process...)"

expectations.text: Uses the FY2025 assessment (1.96 of 5 average) as context for why verification matters
expectations.evidence: The FY2025 assessment and its 1.96/5 average score are never mentioned
